## Today

`AndroidManifest.xml` (app-phone) already declares
`android.permission.health.READ_HEART_RATE`. `ProfileViewModel.init`
already checks `hrPermissionSystem.isGranted()` and, when absent,
calls `hrPermissionSystem.requestPermission()` before ever calling
`hrHistoryReader.bpmValuesOverLast12Months()`; a refused permission
short-circuits the block and never touches `profile.hrMaxBpm`.
`HrHistoryReaderImpl.bpmValuesOverLast12Months` wraps its
`healthConnectClient.readRecords` call in a try/catch that returns
`emptyList()` on any `Exception` (a `SecurityException` from a missing
permission included), never letting it propagate. `ActivityBoundHrPermissionHost`
is bound in `MainActivity.onCreate` with a real
`PermissionController.createRequestPermissionResultContract()`
launcher, and unbound in `onDestroy`. `ProfileViewModelTest` and
`HrHistoryReaderImplTest` already exercise the permission-refused and
read-failure cases described by the gap.
